panels.title: Income
panels.description: External money in over the selected range. Transfers between your own accounts are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' AND txn_type = 'Payment' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND txn_type IN ('ACCT_XFER','PARTNERFI_TO_CHASE','CHASE_TO_PARTNERFI') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND description ILIKE 'CHASE CREDIT CRD AUTOPAY%' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND substring(description FROM 'Payment to Chase card ending in (\d\d\d\d)') IN
           (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions WHERE account_kind = 'credit') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' THEN 'expense'
      WHEN amount >= 0 THEN 'income'
      ELSE 'expense'
    END AS flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions t
)
SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0)::float8 AS "Income"
FROM classified WHERE flow = 'income' AND $__timeFilter(post_date::timestamptz)

panels.title: Monthly income vs expenses
panels.description: Blue bars up: external money in each month. Orange bars down: money out, drawn below zero so the two never overlap. Green line: net. Transfers between your own accounts are excluded from all three.

targets.rawSql:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' AND txn_type = 'Payment' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND txn_type IN ('ACCT_XFER','PARTNERFI_TO_CHASE','CHASE_TO_PARTNERFI') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND description ILIKE 'CHASE CREDIT CRD AUTOPAY%' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND substring(description FROM 'Payment to Chase card ending in (\d\d\d\d)') IN
           (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions WHERE account_kind = 'credit') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' THEN 'expense'
      WHEN amount >= 0 THEN 'income'
      ELSE 'expense'
    END AS flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions t
), m AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', post_date)::timestamptz AS time,
    coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow = 'income'), 0) AS income,
    coalesce(-sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow = 'expense'), 0) AS expenses
  FROM classified WHERE $__timeFilter(post_date::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT time, 'Income' AS metric, income::float8 AS value FROM m
UNION ALL SELECT time, 'Expenses', (-expenses)::float8 FROM m
UNION ALL SELECT time, 'Net', (income - expenses)::float8 FROM m
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Budget — this month, share of total (green = paid)
panels.description: Each bill's share of this month's total budgeted bills, colored by whether it has been paid. Transfer series (card payoffs, savings moves) are excluded; they get their own panel to the right. Always the current calendar month.

targets.rawSql:
WITH occ AS (
  SELECT o.id, -o.amount::float8 AS expected, s.name
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_occurrences o
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_series s ON s.id = o.series_id
  WHERE o.due_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
    AND o.due_date < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + interval '1 month')::date
    AND o.skipped_at IS NULL AND NOT s.is_transfer AND o.amount < 0
), live AS (
  SELECT m.occurrence_id, count(*) AS n
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_matches m
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.transactions t ON t.account_id = m.txn_account_id
    AND t.post_date = m.txn_post_date AND t.description = m.txn_description
    AND t.amount = m.txn_amount AND t.occurrence = m.txn_occurrence
  WHERE m.voided_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1
), tot AS (SELECT sum(expected) AS total FROM occ)
SELECT occ.name AS "Series",
  coalesce(sum(occ.expected) FILTER (WHERE live.n > 0) / tot.total, 0)::float8 AS "Paid",
  coalesce(sum(occ.expected) FILTER (WHERE live.n IS NULL) / tot.total, 0)::float8 AS "Unpaid"
FROM occ LEFT JOIN live ON live.occurrence_id = occ.id CROSS JOIN tot
GROUP BY occ.name, tot.total
ORDER BY sum(occ.expected) DESC

panels.title: Transfers — this month
panels.description: Card autopays and savings moves that pull from checking. Transfers, not spending — card purchases are already in the budget and savings stay yours — but each one still lowers the checking balance on its due date.

targets.rawSql:
WITH occ AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.due_date, o.amount::float8 AS expected, s.name
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_occurrences o
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_series s ON s.id = o.series_id
  WHERE o.due_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
    AND o.due_date < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + interval '1 month')::date
    AND o.skipped_at IS NULL AND s.is_transfer
), live AS (
  SELECT m.occurrence_id, count(*) AS n
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_matches m
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.transactions t ON t.account_id = m.txn_account_id
    AND t.post_date = m.txn_post_date AND t.description = m.txn_description
    AND t.amount = m.txn_amount AND t.occurrence = m.txn_occurrence
  WHERE m.voided_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT occ.due_date::text AS "Due", occ.name AS "Transfer", occ.expected AS "Expected",
  CASE WHEN live.n > 0 THEN 'paid' WHEN occ.due_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'upcoming'
       ELSE 'unpaid' END AS "Status"
FROM occ LEFT JOIN live ON live.occurrence_id = occ.id
ORDER BY occ.due_date

panels.title: Budget — this month
panels.description: Every expected occurrence due this calendar month and what actually paid it. Paid is derived by joining matches to live transactions, so a restated or vanished transaction flips its row back to unpaid. Always the current month — the dashboard time picker does not apply. Matches are made in the pairing TUI (src/cfc_tui.py).

targets.rawSql:
WITH occ AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.due_date, o.amount::float8 AS expected, o.skipped_at,
         s.name, s.category
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_occurrences o
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_series s ON s.id = o.series_id
  WHERE o.due_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
    AND o.due_date < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + interval '1 month')::date
), live2 AS (
  SELECT m.occurrence_id,
         sum(coalesce(m.matched_amount, m.txn_amount))::float8 AS actual,
         count(*) AS n
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_matches m
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.transactions t ON t.account_id = m.txn_account_id
    AND t.post_date = m.txn_post_date AND t.description = m.txn_description
    AND t.amount = m.txn_amount AND t.occurrence = m.txn_occurrence
  WHERE m.voided_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT occ.due_date::text AS "Due", occ.name AS "Series", occ.category AS "Category",
  occ.expected AS "Expected", live2.actual AS "Actual",
  CASE WHEN occ.skipped_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'skipped'
       WHEN live2.n > 0 THEN 'paid'
       WHEN occ.due_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'upcoming'
       ELSE 'unpaid' END AS "Status"
FROM occ LEFT JOIN live2 ON live2.occurrence_id = occ.id
ORDER BY occ.due_date, occ.name

panels.title: Left to pay — this month
panels.description: Expense occurrences due this month that are neither paid nor skipped. Transfer series (card payoffs) are excluded — the card's own purchases are the spending.

targets.rawSql:
WITH occ AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.amount::float8 AS expected, o.skipped_at
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_occurrences o
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_series s ON s.id = o.series_id
  WHERE o.due_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
    AND o.due_date < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + interval '1 month')::date
    AND NOT s.is_transfer
), live AS (
  SELECT m.occurrence_id FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_matches m
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.transactions t ON t.account_id = m.txn_account_id
    AND t.post_date = m.txn_post_date AND t.description = m.txn_description
    AND t.amount = m.txn_amount AND t.occurrence = m.txn_occurrence
  WHERE m.voided_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(-sum(expected) FILTER (WHERE expected < 0 AND skipped_at IS NULL
         AND id NOT IN (SELECT occurrence_id FROM live)), 0) AS "Left to pay"
FROM occ

panels.title: Expected net — this month
panels.description: Sum of every non-skipped, non-transfer expected amount this month: income minus bills.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(o.amount), 0)::float8 AS "Expected net"
FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_occurrences o
JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_series s ON s.id = o.series_id
WHERE o.skipped_at IS NULL AND NOT s.is_transfer
  AND o.due_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
  AND o.due_date < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + interval '1 month')::date

panels.title: Where money goes (transfers excluded)
panels.description: Matched bills are grouped by the expected series they pay (from the pairing TUI); unmatched rows fall back to the card category or bank transaction type. Transfers are excluded — including card payoffs recognized through transfer-flagged series.

targets.rawSql:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' AND txn_type = 'Payment' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND txn_type IN ('ACCT_XFER','PARTNERFI_TO_CHASE','CHASE_TO_PARTNERFI') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND description ILIKE 'CHASE CREDIT CRD AUTOPAY%' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND substring(description FROM 'Payment to Chase card ending in (\d\d\d\d)') IN
           (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions WHERE account_kind = 'credit') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' THEN 'expense'
      WHEN amount >= 0 THEN 'income'
      ELSE 'expense'
    END AS flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions t
),
live_matches AS (
  SELECT m.txn_account_id, m.txn_post_date, m.txn_description, m.txn_amount,
         m.txn_occurrence, coalesce(m.matched_amount, m.txn_amount) AS claimed,
         s.name AS series_name, s.is_transfer, c.flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_matches m
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_occurrences o ON o.id = m.occurrence_id
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_series s ON s.id = o.series_id
  JOIN classified c ON c.account_id = m.txn_account_id AND c.post_date = m.txn_post_date
    AND c.description = m.txn_description AND c.amount = m.txn_amount
    AND c.occurrence = m.txn_occurrence
  WHERE m.voided_at IS NULL
)
SELECT label AS category, sum(v)::float8 AS "Spend" FROM (
  SELECT lm.series_name AS label, -lm.claimed AS v
  FROM live_matches lm
  WHERE lm.flow = 'expense' AND NOT lm.is_transfer
    AND $__timeFilter(lm.txn_post_date::timestamptz)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.account_kind = 'credit' THEN coalesce(nullif(c.category,''),'Card - uncategorized')
      ELSE CASE c.txn_type
        WHEN 'DEBIT_CARD' THEN 'Debit card' WHEN 'CHECK_PAID' THEN 'Checks'
        WHEN 'LOAN_PMT' THEN 'Loan payments' WHEN 'ACH_DEBIT' THEN 'ACH / bill pay'
        WHEN 'MISC_DEBIT' THEN 'Misc debits' WHEN 'FEE_TRANSACTION' THEN 'Fees'
        WHEN 'ATM' THEN 'ATM' ELSE coalesce(c.txn_type,'Other bank') END END, -c.amount
  FROM classified c
  WHERE c.flow = 'expense' AND $__timeFilter(c.post_date::timestamptz)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_matches lm WHERE lm.txn_account_id = c.account_id
      AND lm.txn_post_date = c.post_date AND lm.txn_description = c.description
      AND lm.txn_amount = c.amount AND lm.txn_occurrence = c.occurrence)
) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Income sources
panels.description: Matched income grouped by payer (the income series' sub_category, falling back to the series name) — one employer is one bar however many series and bank descriptions it spans. Unmatched inflows fall back to the first words of the description.

targets.rawSql:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' AND txn_type = 'Payment' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND txn_type IN ('ACCT_XFER','PARTNERFI_TO_CHASE','CHASE_TO_PARTNERFI') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND description ILIKE 'CHASE CREDIT CRD AUTOPAY%' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND substring(description FROM 'Payment to Chase card ending in (\d\d\d\d)') IN
           (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions WHERE account_kind = 'credit') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' THEN 'expense'
      WHEN amount >= 0 THEN 'income'
      ELSE 'expense'
    END AS flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions t
),
live_matches AS (
  SELECT m.txn_account_id, m.txn_post_date, m.txn_description, m.txn_amount,
         m.txn_occurrence, coalesce(m.matched_amount, m.txn_amount) AS claimed,
         s.name AS series_name, s.sub_category AS payer, s.category AS series_category,
         s.is_transfer, c.flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.expected_matches m
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_occurrences o ON o.id = m.occurrence_id
  JOIN cash_flow_commander.expected_series s ON s.id = o.series_id
  JOIN classified c ON c.account_id = m.txn_account_id AND c.post_date = m.txn_post_date
    AND c.description = m.txn_description AND c.amount = m.txn_amount
    AND c.occurrence = m.txn_occurrence
  WHERE m.voided_at IS NULL
)
SELECT label AS source, sum(v)::float8 AS "Income" FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN lm.series_category = 'Income'
         THEN coalesce(nullif(lm.payer, ''), lm.series_name)
         ELSE lm.series_name END AS label, lm.claimed AS v
  FROM live_matches lm
  WHERE lm.flow = 'income' AND NOT lm.is_transfer
    AND $__timeFilter(lm.txn_post_date::timestamptz)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT array_to_string((string_to_array(c.description, ' '))[1:3], ' '), c.amount
  FROM classified c
  WHERE c.flow = 'income' AND $__timeFilter(c.post_date::timestamptz)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_matches lm WHERE lm.txn_account_id = c.account_id
      AND lm.txn_post_date = c.post_date AND lm.txn_description = c.description
      AND lm.txn_amount = c.amount AND lm.txn_occurrence = c.occurrence)
) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Monthly summary
panels.description: Transfers should net to roughly zero each month; a large value there means one side of a card payment fell in a different month, or an untracked account is involved.

targets.rawSql:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' AND txn_type = 'Payment' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND txn_type IN ('ACCT_XFER','PARTNERFI_TO_CHASE','CHASE_TO_PARTNERFI') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND description ILIKE 'CHASE CREDIT CRD AUTOPAY%' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND substring(description FROM 'Payment to Chase card ending in (\d\d\d\d)') IN
           (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions WHERE account_kind = 'credit') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' THEN 'expense'
      WHEN amount >= 0 THEN 'income'
      ELSE 'expense'
    END AS flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions t
)
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', post_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
  coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow = 'income'), 0)::float8 AS "Income",
  coalesce(-sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow = 'expense'), 0)::float8 AS "Expenses",
  coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow <> 'transfer'), 0)::float8 AS "Net",
  coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE flow = 'transfer'), 0)::float8 AS "Transfers (~0)"
FROM classified GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Transactions
panels.description: flow = how each row counts: income, expense, or transfer (excluded from the money panels).

targets.rawSql:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' AND txn_type = 'Payment' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND txn_type IN ('ACCT_XFER','PARTNERFI_TO_CHASE','CHASE_TO_PARTNERFI') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND description ILIKE 'CHASE CREDIT CRD AUTOPAY%' THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'bank' AND substring(description FROM 'Payment to Chase card ending in (\d\d\d\d)') IN
           (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions WHERE account_kind = 'credit') THEN 'transfer'
      WHEN account_kind = 'credit' THEN 'expense'
      WHEN amount >= 0 THEN 'income'
      ELSE 'expense'
    END AS flow
  FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions t
)
SELECT post_date AS "Date", flow, description AS "Description",
       amount::float8 AS "Amount", coalesce(nullif(category,''), '') AS "Category",
       coalesce(txn_type,'') AS "Type"
FROM classified WHERE $__timeFilter(post_date::timestamptz)
ORDER BY post_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT count(*) AS "Transactions", count(DISTINCT account_id) AS "Accounts" FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions

SELECT min(post_date)::text AS "Oldest", max(post_date)::text AS "Newest",
      (CURRENT_DATE - max(post_date))::int AS "Days stale" FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE extra IS NOT NULL) AS "With raw row",
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE raw_document_id IS NOT NULL) AS "Linked to raw doc",
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE occurrence > 0) AS "Needed occurrence" FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', post_date),'YYYY-MM') AS month,
        account_id, count(*) AS txns, sum(amount)::float8 AS net
      FROM cash_flow_commander.transactions
      GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2

panels.title: Months held per account — gaps are the point
